title: Workflows
description: Your sources collect through workflows that run on n8n. Check how each one is doing and set up the server below.
unauthorized: Please sign in again to continue.
forbidden: This action is not allowed for this account.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
serviceUnavailable: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
service.urlHelp: Leave empty to use the server default.
keepSaved: Leave blank to keep the saved value
neverShown: The saved value is hidden. Enter a new one to replace it.
tokenWarning: Changing or removing the webhook token means setting up your existing workflows again; until then they keep using the old token.
test.label: Test connection
test.errorCredentialRequired: Enter an API key to test the connection.
test.errorUnreachable: The n8n service could not be reached.
integration.label: n8n server
integration.help: Values saved here take priority over the server defaults.
disabledWarning: While n8n is off, ingest, activation and wakes are blocked. Workflows already active inside n8n keep running until each source is deactivated.
collectorNote: Each workflow signs in to Umwelt-OS with its own key, created when you activate it. There is no shared key.
